**Major update: User identity handling is now fully automatic and never exposed to users. Workflow and documentation streamlined.**

- User open-id (identity) is now handled only by the backend; user is never asked for, sees, or needs to supply identity parameters.
- Documentation updated to remove all user-facing open-id acquisition and prompts, reflecting automatic and invisible identity binding.
- Skill usage and workflow simplified: users only provide the image/video; all identity, report-linking, and API querying is handled internally.
- Clarified and restyled SKILL.md: denser overview, clear workflow, tabulated sections, and improved formatting for resource and capability indexing.
- Example commands and constraints rewritten to match new identity rules and to align with backend logic.
- Deprecated/redundant files and legacy documentation (such as skill-card.md, old API scripts) removed.

v1.0.1 Changelog

- Updated open-id config file lookup order and unified config file location in documentation and scripts.
- Adjusted config.yaml search path: scripts/config.yaml (skill root) now preferred over skills/smyx_common/scripts/config.yaml.
- Added MIT-0 license field to metadata.
- Removed deprecated documentation file (skill-card.md).
- Improved clarity and accuracy of operation steps and parameter instructions in SKILL.md.

Initial release of "smyx-succulent-special-state-detection-analysis":

- Detects three major succulent health anomalies (black rot, melting, stretching) from HD images or videos.
- Assesses severity and outputs anomaly type with confidence, without giving treatment steps.
- Enforces strict open-id acquisition flow for analysis and history report queries.
- Supports structured Markdown report outputs and automated history listing from cloud only.
- Designed for use at home, in greenhouses, or flower shops, with bilingual (Chinese/English) documentation.
